requirements.text: WHEN the user changes the SIZE axis, the system shall scale text and element sizing on every surface classified as content (ticket cards, list rows, documents navigation rows, and other content-classified surfaces) in the same interaction.
WHEN the user changes the SPACE axis, the system shall adjust padding and gaps on content surfaces without any text-size change.
WHILE any axis combination is set, the system shall render chrome surfaces (header, toolbars, menus, popovers) identically to the default density.
The system shall persist the density choice across reloads and sync it across tabs for all content surfaces, reusing the existing preference layer and events.
WHEN the user activates Reset, the system shall return every content surface to regular size and normal space.
IF a stored legacy (pre-two-axis) density preference exists, THEN the system shall map it to sensible defaults on all surfaces.
Accessibility floor: no axis combination may drop content text below 11px, reduce interactive targets below 24px, or alter color/contrast tokens.

Token purity: newly density-aware surfaces size text and spacing exclusively via density tokens (no raw px/rem font sizes, no JS sizing); a later misclassification is fixable by changing token consumption only.
List-row density changes preserve table alignment and existing row testids.
Reuse existing preference layer, change events, cross-tab sync; stored preference keys/values stay backward-compatible.

obligations.title: Single density-slot token set: all content surfaces consume the existing axis tokens (--fs-xs/--fs-md/--pad-y/--pad-x/--radius-card) directly; derived proportions use calc() in surface CSS; no per-family token sets, no JS sizing
Surface classification inventory (content vs chrome) recorded in THEME.md as rule-derived verdicts; chrome verdict = density-immune by rule
Vendored ui/table.tsx row/cell sizing converted from Tailwind utilities to density tokens; header scales with SIZE to preserve grid alignment; ticket-row testids unchanged
Documents navigation rows (tree/favs/recent) reclassified content: swap --fs-ui* chrome tokens for density tokens; toolbar stays chrome; viewer prose excluded
QuickSearch result rows reclassified content: text-sm/text-xs utilities replaced by density tokens; modal chrome (scope bar, hints) stays chrome
Project selector cards/chips reclassified content (card-mimics, same rule as PinRail)
Ticket detail attribute rows reclassified content: SIZE scales text, SPACE scales row gaps; chrome container untouched

E2E density spec: computed font-size/padding assertions on representative content elements per surface across axis changes, chrome invariance assertions (header/toolbar), and a11y floor at compact·tight
Density persistence/sync reuses the existing preference layer verbatim (no parallel storage); legacy value mapping already shipped and covered by existing unit tests
Styleguide gains a density-aware surface list + live mapping section so the contract is inspectable
